title: Computer Mod by Kilior
description: This Mod adds a Computer to Minecraft wich you can craft.
body: This mod adds a Gaming-PC to Minecraft wich you can craft. You can find Silicium deep in the caves to build it. The crafting recipes can you find in my Discord channel.
